title: The name field has no cursor, so only the end of a name can be edited
body:
The name field that rename and new group open (`NameField` in `src/server/chrome/rename.rs`, from 9c9668c) takes typed characters and Backspace only. The first key typed replaces the old name. Left, Right, Home and End do nothing, so fixing a typo in the middle of a long name means deleting back to it.

## Proposal

The field keeps a cursor that Left, Right, Home and End move, and typing and Backspace act at the cursor. The first key still replaces the whole name unless it is a movement key.
